name: Annabella Keaton
source:
Hobbies: Puzzles
Likes: Quiet spaces
Dislikes: People making noise in the hospital

Director of Chisakura General Hospital. Annabella is calm and composed, and always exudes a quiet atmosphere around her. She seems to be doing some kind of research in the basement of the hospital, but only a few people know about it.

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/mdb-dvd2/cha/mdbdvd_cha06.htm]official website[/url].]
